data.name: Home_SlideshowTitle
data.value: Why I should entrust my project to Net.Créative

data.name: Home_Slide1Text
data.value: My prices are competitive because I always work remotely. This approach allows for substantial savings, which I pass directly on to you.

data.name: Home_Slide2Text
data.value: My 36 years in retail, combined with building DutyFreeOps from the ground up, gave me a real understanding of the systems that actually run a business — not just in theory.

data.name: Home_Slide3Text
data.value: Your project is built entirely by me, without subcontractors, which keeps your website's price as low as possible.

data.name: Home_Slide4Text
data.value: You'll have peace of mind knowing your website and database are hosted in Canada, with Canadian Web Hosting.

data.name: Home_Slide5Text
data.value: My support doesn't stop at delivery: you can reach me by phone anytime, and you'll speak directly with the person who built your site.

data.name: Home_WhoIamTitle
data.value: A passion that's always been with me

data.name: Home_WhoIamParagraph1
data.value: It was during the COVID-19 pandemic, while working as store manager at Boutique Hors Taxes de la Beauce Inc., that I started developing my programming skills — first to solve my own problems, then out of genuine passion.

data.name: Home_WhoIamParagraph2
data.value: Now the owner of the shop, I went on to build DutyFreeOps, the system that runs all of its operations: products, pricing, promotions, suppliers, HR and reporting. A project born from a real need, built on more than 30 years of retail experience.

data.name: Home_WhoIamParagraph3
data.value: That same passion also leads me to design websites under the Net.Créative banner, for businesses that, like mine, want a solution built around their real needs instead of a generic template.

data.name: Home_WhoIamParagraph4
data.value: Whether it's a software project or a website, my approach stays the same: listen, understand, then build a tool that actually serves its purpose. I'd be glad to talk it over with you.

data.name: DutyFreeOps_HeroText
data.value: The management system I designed and built to run my own duty-free shop, day in and day out.

data.name: DutyFreeOps_Intro
data.value: DutyFreeOps was born out of a real need: replacing the aging systems that ran Boutique Hors Taxes de la Beauce's operations. Rather than adapting an off-the-shelf tool, I chose to design and build my own solution, built around the real needs of a duty-free business — from products all the way to customs compliance.

data.name: Service_HeroText
data.value: Design, hosting and SEO — a website built to turn visitors into customers.

data.name: Service_Intro
data.value: Every project starts with understanding your business, to deliver a site that's simple, fast and easy to keep up to date.

data.name: Service_Item1
data.value: Every site is custom-built for your business from scratch — never a generic template. The design reflects your brand, and the experience is built to turn visitors into customers.

data.name: Service_Item2
data.value: Your website and database are hosted with Canadian Web Hosting, on servers located in Canada. Your data stays under Canadian law, with technical support available when you need it.

data.name: Service_Item3
data.value: Every page is structured to rank well on Google: proper tags, fast load times, and optimized content. Your site is built to be found easily, not just to look good.

data.name: Service_Item4
data.value: In 2026, your website's code is no longer hand-written by a programmer — it's generated with the help of AI, resulting in far fewer errors and faster, more affordable development for you. I build with ASP.NET for the language's security and robustness.

data.name: Service_Item5
data.value: Your site is tested across major browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) and on mobile, tablet, and desktop, so it displays and works correctly no matter what device your visitors use.

data.name: Service_Item6
data.value: I design custom icons that match your brand's colors and style, instead of generic icons found online — a small detail that gives your site a polished, cohesive look.

data.name: Service_Client1
data.value: Have a copy of your logo in the best possible resolution.

data.name: Service_Client2
data.value: Have photos of your business, your team, your achievements, always with the best possible resolution.

data.name: Service_Client3
data.value: Write about your company, your products and services, and what sets you apart from the competition.

data.name: Service_Client4
data.value: Check out other websites and decide what you like about the design and functionality.

data.name: Service_Client5
data.value: Stay relevant and clear — visitors avoid sites filled with vague text. Put yourself in your potential customer's shoes.

data.name: Service_Client6
data.value: The more clearly you define your objective, the better the result will be and the lower the price will be.
